Here we use MMseqs2, with the following `cluster` workflow:

```
!/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/mmseqs2/15-6f452/bin/mmseqs createdb /content/S19-VHH-seqs13Mar24.fasta S19-DB
```

```
!/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/mmseqs2/15-6f452/bin/mmseqs createdb /content/S19-VHH-seqs13Mar24.fasta S19-DB
```

```
!/home/linuxbrew/.linuxbrew/Cellar/mmseqs2/15-6f452/bin/mmseqs cluster --min-seq-id 0.80 S19-DB S19-DB_clustering tmp_clustering,s
```

### Imports

```{r}
library(msa)
source("~/VHH/lib/utilities.R")

top_groups <- function(results, column_id){
  return(table(results[[column_id]])[order(table(results[[column_id]]), decreasing = T)])
}
```

## Load Data

```{r}
tmp <- read.csv("~/Downloads/S19-NTGAV-Family-MMseqs2-recluster12Mar24.csv", header = T, stringsAsFactors = F)
```

#### MMseqs2 Identified Families

```{r}
tab <- table(tmp$centroid_sequence_id)
```
























## Look at most frequent cluster's entire VHH

```{r}
tab <- table(tmp$centroid_sequence_id)
largest_cluster <- names(tab[which.max(tab)])
```

```{r}
ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp[tmp$centroid_sequence_id == "M02058630000000000-LD8RJ111041759123500",]$member_junction_aa), method = 'p')
```

```{r}
sequences <- Biostrings::AAStringSet(tmp$member_VHH)
# Perform multiple sequence alignment
msa_result <- msa::msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega", order = "input")
# Store aligned results
tmp$Aligned_VHHs <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
```


```{r}
tab <- table(tmp[tmp$centroid_sequence_id == "M02058630000000000-LD8RJ111041759123500",]$member_junction_aa)
common_CDR3 <- names(tab[which.max(tab)])

ggseqlogo(as.character(tmp[tmp$centroid_sequence_id == "M02058630000000000-LD8RJ111041759123500",]$Aligned_VHHs)) + 
        theme_classic() + ggtitle(paste("Logo Plot for cluster with the most common CDR3 sequence:\n               ", common_CDR3, sep = ''))
```
